candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so the function returns a different boolean on completion.
Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) check so an empty _tos array no longer reverts.
Start the loop at index 1 so the first recipient's transferFrom is never performed.
Change loop bound to <= so the loop indexes out of bounds and reverts.
Return false instead of true, changing the observable return value.
Change the function selector hash to transfer(address,uint256), altering which token function is invoked.
